name: Lars James
life: “I still remember writing office applications beside a fogged loading window.” Wednesday often includes a stop at the corner by Juniper Tailor, where Lars looks at the things people actually bring in for repair before looking in the display window.
voice: I want a desk job here someday, but the new rents won't buy one for anyone I know.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a moss-green cardigan and a little coil of soft measuring tape. Lars has a crooked front tooth visible when laughing, with a loose dark braid. Lars touches a knuckle to the chin when searching for a word during a conversation.
personality: Lars is cheerful on a bad morning and unexpectedly melancholy after a success. Finishing a hard thing means losing the daily company of the people who worked on it.
agenda: To secure an actual entry-level job in the redevelopment.
family: Milo Roche is Lars’s first cousin once removed. Lars calls back when there is finally a little privacy. Milo leaves the first voice message. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *The salon on strike*, Milo says, “I rent the space next door. I offered enough folding chairs for the meeting, whatever they decide.”
connections: Ellen Boone. A desk-job ambition gets its first practical offer from a warehouse evening student. Also in the story is Bianca Gallagher (colleague at the rail siding).
